messages:
Ravi: Postmortem follow-up: we need a clear customer comms handoff for the Apr outage. Items: one-line statuspage blurb, 72h public summary, enterprise outreach, and RCA access policy. Also capture owners and deadlines.

Hannah: I can write the 72h public summary. Requesting until 2024-04-26 18:00 PT to include legal redactions.

Jo: I'll do the enterprise outreach templates and coordinate CS briefings. ETA 2024-04-26 COB.

Marcus: Draft statuspage blurb proposal: 
```
Status: Partial service disruption 1 Resolved
Summary: Brief interruption to embeddings endpoint between 03:1203:42 UTC; we mitigated the impact and are investigating. A summary will be posted within 72 hours.
```

Tess: Small wording tweak: replace "interrupt0n" with "service degradation" and add link text for requesting more info. Also, what's our default on sharing detailed RCAs?

Ravi: Default policy: public redacted summary on statuspage; impacted customers may request a detailed RCA via Support. Sensitive details may require an NDA. Tess, can you draft the single-line policy blurb?

Tess: Drafted: "A redacted summary is available publicly; verified impacted customers may request a detailed RCA through Support. Sensitive information may be shared under NDA at Legal's discretion." Sending to Legal now.

incident-bot: Ticket INC-4799 created and assigned to Jo for enterprise outreach. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-4799

Hannah: 72h public summary outline: timeline, impact, mitigations, mitigations for recurrence note, next steps and link to support for RCA requests. I'll include a short paragraph referencing a recurring KV cache eviction pattern and assign follow-up SRE task if needed.

Marcus: Statuspage deploy plan: staging preview at 2024-04-25 17:30 PT, target publish 2024-04-25 18:00 PT after legal signoff.

Jo: Enterprise templates ready by 2024-04-26. Will offer 1:1 briefings for materially impacted accounts and include a suggested CS script.

Ravi: Action list to add to tracker: statuspage copy (Marcus) -> publish 4/25 18:00; 72h public summary (Hannah) -> 4/26 18:00; enterprise outreach (Jo) -> 4/26 COB; RCA policy text (Tess) -> legal signoff by 4/28; SRE recurrence task -> open if Hannah flags it.
